## 08-brightness: NOT TESTED

- Lead-confirmed constraint: the user forbids changing system settings, so
  this run did NOT change display brightness by any means (no DisplayServices,
  no SMC writes, no SMC brightness keys).
- Public-API probe result at run time:
  ```
  RESULT=NO_DISPLAY_SERVICE 
  ```
  i.e. CGDisplayIOServicePort(CGMainDisplayID()) returns 0 (no IODisplay
  service on Apple Silicon), so the public IODisplayGet/SetFloatParameter
  brightness path is unusable; there is no public CoreGraphics/AppKit setter.
- What is recorded instead: PDBR (backlight power, SMC) in every phase, and
  it is treated as the brightness-coupled channel. Brightness itself is
  NOT controlled and NOT measured in this run.
- Prior read-only PoC evidence (docs/battery-power-flow.md): PDBR 8.1 W at full
  brightness -> 0.4 W at 30%, i.e. PDBR tracks backlight, not load. That is
  prior evidence, not a measurement of this run.
